pages.title: Never an Empty Hand
pages.text: Maintain a working stack without manual shuffling; an upgrade base and alloy support the next build.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Consume a selected item/block and let the upgrade transfer real stock from the backpack. Advanced Refill adds precise slot targeting and middle-click block picking; it creates no items.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Refill maintains a selected player stack from real backpack stock; advanced adds precise slots and middle-click block selection.
